title: S4-DRAW-13 — Eyedropper samples the art.
goal: The Eyedropper takes the exact color of the sampled artwork pixel into the Primary well, without changing artwork or adding an Undo step. The fixture is a replay with a known #2a9d8f pixel at the canvas centre.

steps.why: Choose the tool from the toolbar.
The sampled centre pixel's exact color becomes the Primary color.
Sampling added no Undo step: one Undo removes the replay's own last step, the centre pixel.
